name: Project health
description: Whether the work is moving, how far along each project is, and who is carrying what.
long_description:
The dashboard to open before a check-in. The top row answers the three questions somebody always asks — how much is open, how much is late, how much got finished lately — and says how far along the whole thing is.

Underneath, each project's finished and remaining work sits side by side, so a project that has stopped moving is visible next to one that has not. The board deals every open task into a column per person, each card led by its project, which is the fastest way to see who is carrying what and where it came from.

Nothing here needs setting up — every widget reads the initiative the dashboard lives on. Read-only, like every dashboard: it shows the work, and the work is changed where it lives.
release_notes: Says how far along each project is rather than only how many tasks it has, adds what is late and what was finished lately, and a board showing who is carrying what.

binding.sql: SELECT count(*) AS open FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL
SELECT count(*) AS overdue FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND due_date < now()
SELECT count(*) AS finished FROM tasks WHERE completed_at >= now() - CAST('30 days' AS interval)
SELECT count(completed_at) AS finished, count(*) AS total FROM tasks
SELECT p.name AS project, count(t.completed_at) AS finished, count(*) - count(t.completed_at) AS remaining FROM projects p JOIN tasks t ON t.project_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name
SELECT assignee.display_name AS person, count(*) AS open FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL GROUP BY assignee.display_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC
SELECT concat(project.name, ' · ', title) AS card, assignee.display_name AS person, due_date FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL ORDER BY project.name, due_date

SELECT p.name AS project, count(*) - count(t.completed_at) AS open, count(*) AS total FROM projects p JOIN tasks t ON t.project_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY count(*) - count(t.completed_at) DESC
